_note: The pictures the museum made itself that may leave under CC BY-SA 4.0 alone: verdict 1 of the rights list (section B, and the share images and charts made for the topic pages). A picture is named by the stem of its files: a file is its stem, then -<width> or -<width>x<height>, then its type. Only these carry licence data in a page's structured data, and the build stops on licence data for any other picture. A picture joins this list only after its rights reading: a still that shows a reproduction, the house or its grounds (map data), the sky, or a film never does.
